# NEW 2026-11-17 conquest campaigns (phase 1 + 2). Generated by gen_heg_campaigns.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_hc_egypt_declare = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { scope:actor = { oe_heg_action_visible = yes has_variable = oe_heg_egypt_plan_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } } }
    allow = { scope:actor = { oe_hc_egypt_declare_allowed = yes } }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_hc_declare_tt
            hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { oe_hc_egypt_declare_allowed = yes } oe_hc_egypt_start = yes } }
        }
    }
}
oe_hc_egypt_pay = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { scope:actor = { tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            gold >= 300
            custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_PAY_COOLDOWN NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_pay_cd } }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            add_gold = -300
            custom_tooltip = oe_hc_pay_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = { amount = -15 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_hc_pay_cd months = 6 }
            }
        }
    }
}

        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            add_gold = -300
            custom_tooltip = oe_hc_pay_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                oe_hc_arabia_add_pressure = { amount = -15 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_hc_pay_cd months = 6 }
            }
        }
    }
}
oe_hc_arabia_peace = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { scope:actor = { tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } }
    allow = { scope:actor = { custom_tooltip = { text = OE_HC_PEACE_REQUIRES has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_progress var:oe_hc_arabia_progress >= 40 } } }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_hc_peace_tt
            hidden_effect = { oe_hc_arabia_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        }
    }
}
